cohort: 5888 pregnant women enrolled between 2018 and 2021 from the Weifang Maternal and Child Health hospital of Shandong, China.
finding: Increased ambient PM2.5 exposure throughout pregnancy was associated with a significantly increased risk of PTB, while installation of double-glazed windows and living on the 5th floor or above were associated with a significantly reduced risk of PTB.
gest_age: Preterm birth (<37 completed weeks of gestation)
